svg.title: Levels of help
svg.desc: Three levels. First, self-help and people you trust: breathing, sleep, movement, worry time, and talking it through. Second, if that isn't enough or it lasts: a help line, clinic, doctor or counsellor. Third, if a life is at risk: the emergency number or a crisis line, straight away. Numbers by country are in facts.md.
svg.text: Numbers for your country are in facts.md.
Breathing, sleep, movement, worry time, talking it through.
A help line, clinic, doctor or counsellor.
The emergency number or a crisis line, straight away. Don't wait.
Sources: WHO, stress; NHS, urgent help for mental health; NIMH, find help. Not medical advice.
